translations.title: Vitamin C 1000 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to prevent and treat scurvy, to supply vitamin C during pregnancy and breastfeeding or when your strength is low during and after illness or from physical fatigue, and for capillary bleeding such as bleeding gums or nose and for pigmentation when vitamin C deficiency is suspected.
translations.usage: Adults take 500–1,000 mg once a day or in several divided doses, with plenty of water, and do not lie down straight after taking it.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have high urinary oxalate, thalassaemia, gout, cystinuria, G6PD deficiency, or kidney oxalate stones. Talk to a pharmacist if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, smoke, or drink heavily, and be careful about kidney stones with long-term high-dose use.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Scurvy; suspected vitamin C deficiency; capillary bleeding such as bleeding gums or nose
summaryTable.Who should be careful: People with oxalate stones, gout, thalassaemia or G6PD deficiency, or on long-term high-dose use
summaryTable.Why this one: A high-dose single-ingredient vitamin C tablet

summary: Scurvy prevention and vitamin C supplementation
